title: Hybrid Architecture
subtitle: We combine the privacy of local processing with the power of the cloud to give you the best of both worlds.

client.title: Local Processing (Client-side)
client.desc: These tools run entirely in your browser using pdf-lib. Your files never leave your device, ensuring total privacy and speed.
client.guaranteeDesc: Zero uploads. Processing happens on your hardware, eliminating any risk of data interception.

server.title: Server-side Processing
server.desc: For high-complexity computational tasks, we use a specialized Python backend that ensures surgical precision in document handling.
server.guaranteeDesc: End-to-end encryption. Files are permanently and automatically deleted from our infrastructure after processing.
